ValidationRule.description: 2020-09-14 Case 56132 Require TaaS Fields 2020-09-18 Add Status = "Active" Server_Device_Type__c (Picklist Value) : - "Tanium as a Service" (API Name) = "Tanium Cloud" (Label) SS-8288 - Cloud_Region field to replace Taas_Region.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c)= "Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government", TEXT(Server_Device_Type__c)= "Tanium as a Service"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Active"), OR( LEN( TEXT(Cloud_Region__c ))=0, ISBLANK( Vanity_URL__c ), ISBLANK( Tanium_Cloud_Admin__c )), NOT($Profile.Name="API Only Integration Admin"), NOT($Profile.Name = "Tanium System Administrator"), NOT($Profile.Name="System Administrator"), NOT($Profile.Name="API Only Integration"), RecordType.DeveloperName ='TaaS' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Tanium Cloud or Tanium Cloud for U.S. Government is selected in the Infrastructure-License Key Purpose field, you must populate the Vanity, Cloud Region, and Tanium Cloud Admin fields. Please check those fields are updated to save your record.
